item.title: SUNshine Girl Caitlyn
item.description: SUNshine Girl Caitlyn is a freelance model, burgeoning entrepreneur and proud member of the Haudenosaunee Mohawk Nation. The 5-foot-9 red-headed Scorpio enjoys painting, playing lacrosse and working on her culinary skills. (JACK BOLAND/TORONTO SUN)
